caption: Opening plenary on cross-border payments at Landmark Hall A.
message: Energized by the caliber of discussions today. Africa's payments rails are evolving faster than ever.

caption: Founders & Investors round table after panel session.
message: Met over 15 incredible early-stage teams building real fintech infrastructure. Kudos to the organizers!

caption: Audience during the AI in Banking keynote.
message: Flawless organization, lightning fast badge check-in, and world-class networking. See you next year!

caption: Chief Adeleke with family during his 80th milestone Thanksgiving service.
message: A gentle giant, wise counselor, and the bedrock of our family. Your memory remains a blessing to all generations.
Emmanuel, 58 years together were the greatest honor of my life. You loved without reservation and served God with humility. Till we meet at Jesus' feet.

caption: Chief Adeleke receiving Lifetime Leadership Honors in 2018.
message: We mourn the passage of a past president and visionary commercial statesman whose wisdom shaped Nigerian trade for decades.

caption: Our pre-wedding celebration shoot in Lagos.
message: Counting down the days until we celebrate with all of our favorite people under one roof!
